FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept_relationship` cr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.concept` c2 ON cr.concept_id_2 = c2.concept_id
WHERE cr.concept_id_1 IN (133834, 140168, 138502, 141095)
  AND cr.relationship_id = 'Subsumes'
ORDER BY cr.concept_id_1, cr.concept_id_2
